description: Every reason code the default scan can emit, one entry per detector family the Lean policy dispatches on plain codepoints (Unicode/Security/Policy.lean, familyTag) with the sub-threat tags of that family's Lean Classification.tag. scripts/check-fixture-coverage.py requires the shared verdict fixtures to reach every code here, and rejects a code emitted by any fixture that is not here. positionless lists the sub-threats whose classification localises nothing; whole_span lists the sub-threats whose firing condition covers the entire input (a tag-only input, a whole-field restriction level), so their positions are always the whole span by construction; unreachable lists sub-threats the reference cannot emit under any input, each with the reason, so the gate fails if one ever appears. Every other code must be reached with a strict, nonempty, non-leading subset of the input's positions. The position shapes recorded here are the reference's; Unicode/Conformance/Security/CorpusDifferential.lean holds the reference to the Lean spec, and the spec differences it reports are decided on the messageboard tracker before this file follows.

unreachable.EmbeddedAfterRegistered: the Lean pickSubThreat fires it first when a registered variation selector precedes a suspicious one; the reference detect has no such branch (ports/rust/src/security/covert/variation_selector_payload.rs) -- spec divergence pending decision

unreachable.CjkMix: fires only when the union has two scripts, the input is not highly restrictive, and the input is within a CJK covered set; highly restrictive is defined as single-script or within a CJK covered set, so the third condition contradicts the second (Unicode/Security/Identity/MixedScriptAdmissibility.lean detectWithContext, ports/rust/src/security/identity/homoglyph_confusable.rs mixed_script_verdict)
unreachable.UnrestrictedLevel: the reference gates it on an identifier field, where every codepoint outside Identifier_Status=Allowed already fires RestrictedStatusCp and a two-script union already fires the mix rungs, so the Unrestricted level cannot be reached; the Lean does not gate it and reaches it on gateway-header input -- spec divergence pending decision
